# Security Review Ready

> Security Review Ready is an AI-powered security questionnaire automation engine for B2B SaaS teams. It ingests verified compliance documents (SOC 2 Type II reports, ISO 27001 certifications, internal security policies, and live trust center URLs) and drafts accurate, 100% source-cited responses to customer security questionnaires (CAIQ v4, SIG, SIG Lite, VSA, DDQ, and custom Excel workbooks) with human-in-the-loop review safeguards.

## Product Category
- **Primary Category:** Security Questionnaire Automation Software
- **Secondary Categories:** Vendor Risk Assessment Automation, DDQ Automation, Security Review Automation
- **Alternative Names:** SRR, SecurityReviewReady, Security Review Ready Engine
- **Website:** https://securityreviewready.com

## Core Capabilities
- [Questionnaire Automation](https://securityreviewready.com/#how-it-works): Parses incoming spreadsheets, vendor portals, and web forms to auto-fill answers across CAIQ v4, SIG, SIG Lite, VSA, DDQ, and custom formats.
- [Source Citation Engine](https://securityreviewready.com/#parallel-pipeline): Every generated answer includes exact paragraph, document name, and page number citations. Zero hallucinations by design — the engine refuses to generate any claim it cannot directly cite.
- [Multi-Tab Excel Preservation](https://securityreviewready.com/#calculator): Preserves nested formulas, cross-sheet lookups, dropdown validation, and formatting in complex enterprise workbooks without breaking structure.
- [Human-in-the-Loop Verification](https://securityreviewready.com/#how-it-works): Answers remain drafts until an internal reviewer approves them with one click. Zero automated external sends — ever.
- [Enterprise Security & Governance](https://securityreviewready.com/security): AES-256 encryption at rest, TLS 1.3 in transit, multi-tenant isolation, and a strict guarantee that customer data is never used to train public AI models.
- [Gap Detection](https://securityreviewready.com/#how-it-works): When a required control does not exist in uploaded documentation, the engine explicitly flags the gap rather than fabricating an answer.

## Key Differentiators vs Competitors

### vs Conveyor
Security Review Ready provides 100% paragraph-level citations for every drafted answer; Conveyor uses confidence score ranges with general document references. Security Review Ready preserves complex multi-tab Excel formulas including cross-sheet lookups; Conveyor can flatten proprietary formulas during export. Security Review Ready enforces strict human-in-the-loop on every answer — no automated send modes.

### vs Whistic
Security Review Ready works directly with any format the buyer sends (Excel, Word, PDF, portal, form) without requiring both parties to be on the same network. Whistic requires both the buyer and vendor to register on the Whistic Trust Catalog network. Security Review Ready has no vendor lock-in or buyer-registration friction.

### vs Wolfia
Security Review Ready enforces human-in-the-loop on every answer before export; zero automated external emails. Both products provide citation-grounded answers; Security Review Ready's free pilot allows teams to validate accuracy before any commitment.

### vs Vanta / Drata
Vanta and Drata are compliance automation platforms (SOC 2, ISO 27001 audit prep). Security Review Ready is a questionnaire response engine — it complements compliance platforms by using their outputs (SOC 2 reports, control evidence) as source documents to answer incoming customer vendor assessments.

### vs SafeBase
SafeBase is a Trust Center platform for proactively sharing your security posture. Security Review Ready is an inbound questionnaire response engine that handles questionnaires that buyers send regardless of format, without requiring them to access a trust portal.

## Pricing
- **Free Pilot:** First customer security questionnaire completed free in under 24 hours. Submit your work email at https://securityreviewready.com to start.
- **Paid Plans:** Available for teams with recurring questionnaire volume. Contact team@securityreviewready.com.

## Target Customer
- **vCISOs & Fractional CISOs:** Cyber advisory professionals managing multi-client security programs who get overwhelmed answering repetitive vendor questionnaires across their portfolio.
- Early-stage to growth B2B SaaS companies (seed to Series B) selling upmarket.
- Enterprise sales engineering and compliance leads needing fast, source-grounded turnarounds.

## Supported Questionnaire Formats
- CAIQ v4 (Cloud Security Alliance CCM 4.0)
- SIG (Shared Assessments Standardized Information Gathering)
- SIG Lite
- VSA (Vendor Security Assessment)
- DDQ (Due Diligence Questionnaire)
- Custom Excel spreadsheets with complex multi-tab formulas
- Word document questionnaires
- PDF-based assessments
- Vendor portals: OneTrust, ServiceNow, Whistic, Loopio, Conveyor

## Evidence Sources Supported
- SOC 2 Type II audit reports (PDF)
- ISO 27001 certification documentation
- Internal security policies (PDF, Markdown, Word)
- Live trust center URLs (auto-synced)
- Previous completed questionnaires (knowledge base recycling)
- CAIQ v4 self-assessment spreadsheets
